This two-mode setup is perfect for winding down, relaxing after a long day, or creating a consistent nighttime routine. Quick tip: In Bluetooth mode, volume depends on both your phone and the speaker—adjust both if it sounds too low.

With the auto-off sleep timer, you can choose 30/60/90 minutes and let the sleep pillow speaker shut off automatically while you drift off. It’s especially helpful if you listen to white noise, bedtime stories, or long podcasts and don’t want sound playing all night or waking you up later.

This ultra-thin under-pillow speaker (11mm) is made to stay low-profile and sit flat under your pillow—no big bump, no weird pillow shape, no constant readjusting. At about 1.5oz (48g) and 9.6cm wide, it’s a compact mini portable sleep speaker that feels simple and unobtrusive for nightly use at home, in a dorm, or while traveling.

The 300mAh battery delivers up to 10 hours playback (at 60% volume)—enough for a full night routine—and USB-C charging makes it easy to recharge and use again tomorrow. And if anything isn’t right, just reach out—our support team will help you get it sorted.
